collection.label: Ludlul bel nemeqi (cuneiform tablets)
collection.critical_edition: electronic Babylonian Library, Righteous Sufferer (Ludlul bel nemeqi) (ed. A. Hätinen), manuscript transliterations
collection.original_lang_label: Akkadian · eBL transliteration of each tablet
collection.search_terms: ludlul bel nemeqi righteous sufferer babylonian job shubshi-meshre-shakkan marduk wisdom
collection.description: Ludlul bel nemeqi, the Babylonian Poem of the Righteous Sufferer, read line by line on photographed clay tablets, with each tablet's own transliteration and B. R. Foster's English translation from the electronic Babylonian Library.

authors.name: Shubshi-meshre-Shakkan
authors.bio: Babylonian official named as the speaker of Ludlul bel nemeqi; a man of this name is attested in the time of the Kassite king Nazi-Maruttash (13th c. BCE).
